comparison.objective: Configure a control panel from a setup sheet and initiate a two-hand start; candidate physically adjusts a damper, then operates a guarded test control and tunes from measured response.
comparison.physical_skill: PR manipulates switches, a detented dial, sliders, and two buttons based on printed settings. Candidate seats a fine hex tool, manipulates a captive lock and small collar, reacquires a moved socket, and iterates using real carriage dynamics.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires exact P2 control settings and a synchronized 2 s two-button start, with forbidden-button failures. Candidate requires two consecutive impact cycles satisfying energy, travel, velocity, force, rebound, and drift constraints.
comparison.reason: Guarded control actuation and a rotary setting are shared primitives, but PR tests instruction-following panel setup; the candidate tests mechanical locking plus closed-loop dynamic commissioning.
